# hookbase_source (Resource)

Manages a Hookbase inbound webhook source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Basic Stripe webhook source
resource "hookbase_source" "stripe" {
  name          = "stripe-production"
  slug          = "stripe-prod"
  provider_type = "stripe"
  signing_secret = var.stripe_webhook_secret
  reject_invalid_signatures = true
}

# GitHub source with IP filtering
resource "hookbase_source" "github" {
  name           = "github-webhooks"
  slug           = "github"
  provider_type  = "github"
  ip_filter_mode = "allowlist"
  ip_allowlist   = ["140.82.112.0/20", "185.199.108.0/22"]
}

# High-security source with deduplication and transient mode
resource "hookbase_source" "payments" {
  name               = "payment-events"
  slug               = "payments"
  provider_type      = "custom"
  dedup_enabled      = true
  dedup_strategy     = "idempotency_key"
  dedup_window_hours = 48
  transient_mode     = true  # HIPAA compliance — no payload storage
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Source name (1-100 characters).
- `slug` (String) URL-safe identifier. Lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens only. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `dedup_custom_header` (String) Custom header name for idempotency key dedup strategy.
- `dedup_enabled` (Boolean) Enable event deduplication.
- `dedup_strategy` (String) Deduplication strategy: auto, provider_id, payload_hash, idempotency_key, or none.
- `dedup_window_hours` (Number) Deduplication window in hours (1-168).
- `description` (String) Source description.
- `encrypt_fields` (List of String) Field names to encrypt.
- `ip_allowlist` (List of String) IP addresses or CIDR ranges to allow.
- `ip_denylist` (List of String) IP addresses or CIDR ranges to deny.
- `ip_filter_mode` (String) IP filtering mode: none, allowlist, denylist, or both.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the source is active.
- `mask_fields` (List of String) Field names to mask in the UI.
- `provider_type` (String) Webhook provider type: github, stripe, shopify, slack, twilio, custom, or generic.
- `rate_limit_per_minute` (Number) Rate limit per minute (1-100000). Requires paid plan.
- `reject_invalid_signatures` (Boolean) Reject webhooks with invalid signatures.
- `signing_secret` (String, Sensitive) Webhook signing secret. Auto-generated if not provided.
- `transient_mode` (Boolean) Discard payloads after routing (HIPAA/GDPR compliance).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Source ID.
- `ingest_url` (String) The public URL for sending webhooks to this source.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
